notes: On today's Manager Meeting, Tim McCusker interviews Jack Sommers. Tim is the CIO at NEPC and a past guest on Capital Allocators. He oversees investment research and strategy for the $1.5 trillion consultant. Jack is the co-founder and Executive Chair at Income Research and Management, a $90B core fixed income investment firm. He was instrumental in developing IR+M's disciplined bottom-up investment approach and served as a Portfolio Manager for 20 years. Their conversation covers the early days of IR+M, when Jack and his father faced the challenges of establishing an investment management business, growth of the business over time, evolving landscape for active fixed income investing, and importance of culture.  Jack Sommers – Core Fixed Income at IR+M (Manager Meetings, EP.39) Oct 20, 2022

 On today’s Manager Meeting, Tim McCusker interviews Jack
Sommers. Tim is the CIO at NEPC and a past guest on Capital
Allocators. He oversees investment research and strategy for the
$1.5 trillion consultant. Jack is the co-founder and Executive
Chair at Income Research and Management, a $90B core fixed income
investment firm. He was instrumental in developing IR+M’s
disciplined bottom-up investment approach and served as a Portfolio
Manager for 20 years. Their conversation covers the early days of
IR+M, when Jack and his father faced the challenges of establishing
an investment management business, growth of the business over
time, evolving landscape for active fixed income investing, and
importance of culture.

 About the Podcast 
 
 
 Allocator and asset management expert, Ted Seides, conducts in-depth interviews with leaders in the institutional investing industry. Guests include Chief Investment Officers from leading allocators, asset managers, strategists, thought leaders, and many more. Our mission is to learn, share, and help implement the process of premier investors. Learn more and join our community at capitalallocators.com.
